description: Deterministic validation checklists and automated probes for Atlassian Cloud, Atlassian Data Center, and Developer/Observability tool connectors (Jira Cloud, Jira DC, Confluence Cloud, Confluence DC, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, PagerDuty, Sourcegraph, and Grafana).

sections.title: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) App Registration & Automated Health
sections.description: Register an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) integration in the Atlassian Developer Console, configure callback URLs, enable user email visibility, and verify automated connector health.

items.label: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) App Client ID & Secret
items.subLabel: Create an OAuth 2.0 Integration in the Atlassian Developer Console, enable Distribution Sharing (Vendor: Google, Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com), and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.

items.label: Callback / Redirect URLs Registered
items.subLabel: Register https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/console/oauth/jira_oauth.html (Data Ingestion & Actions) and https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect (Federated Search & Actions).

items.label: Rotating Refresh Tokens / offline_access
items.subLabel: Ensure OAuth 2.0 (3LO) rotating refresh tokens (offline_access) are enabled so Gemini Enterprise can refresh authorization tokens in the background.

items.label: User Email Visibility Set to Public / Anyone
items.subLabel: In Jira Settings > System > General Configuration, set 'User email visibility' to 'Public', and in Atlassian Account Profile and visibility > Contact, set visibility to 'Anyone'. Also grant 'User access admin' and 'Product admin' roles to the connector group.

items.label: Discovery Engine IAM & Service Agent Permissions
items.subLabel: Verifies the host GCP project has required Discovery Engine Editor and Service Agent permissions.

automatedProbe.description: Validates Discovery Engine IAM permissions on the target Google Cloud project.

items.label: Connector Endpoint & Auth State Check
items.subLabel: Verifies non-redacted instance/tenant parameters, actionConfig state, and absence of 401/OAuth errors in GCP (note: client_id, client_secret, and vendor portal scopes are redacted by GCP on read and must be attested manually above).

automatedProbe.description: Verifies non-redacted connector endpoint/tenant parameters and checks for backend OAuth/auth errors in Discovery Engine.

items.label: Connector State & Sync Health
items.subLabel: Validates that the Jira Cloud connector is ACTIVE in Discovery Engine with no failing authentication or sync operations.

automatedProbe.description: Checks Discovery Engine connector state and latest sync operation logs.

sections.title: Classic & Granular Read Scopes

items.label: read:jira-work (Classic Scope)

items.label: read:jira-user (Classic Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to fetch and display user profile details in real-time during Federated Search.

items.label: read:user:jira (Ingestion Granular Scope)

items.label: read:group:jira (Ingestion Granular Scope)

items.label: read:audit-log:jira (Ingestion Granular Scope)

items.label: read:sprint:jira-software (Ingestion Granular Scope)

items.label: read:issue:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading Jira issues in real-time Federated Search.

items.label: read:issue-type:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading issue types in Federated Search.

items.label: read:comment:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading issue comments in Federated Search.

items.label: read:comment.property:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading issue comment properties in Federated Search.

items.label: read:project:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading Jira projects and metadata in Federated Search.

items.label: read:priority:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading issue priority levels in Federated Search.

items.label: read:issue.transition:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading workflow status transitions for issues in Federated Search.

items.label: read:issue-meta:jira (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading issue metadata and field configurations in Federated Search.

items.label: read:board-scope.admin:jira-software (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading Jira Software board admin configurations in Federated Search.

items.label: read:board-scope:jira-software (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading Jira Software board scopes in Federated Search.

items.label: read:sprint:jira-software (Federated Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows reading Jira Software sprints in Federated Search.

items.label: read:issue-details:jira (Federated Granular Scope)

sections.title: User Identity Accessor for Jira Cloud
sections.description: Required for Jira Cloud Data Ingestion to securely resolve user email addresses and map ACLs when Atlassian profile email visibility is restricted.

items.label: Install 'User Identity Accessor for Jira Cloud'
items.subLabel: Navigate to Atlassian Marketplace, search for 'User Identity Accessor for Jira Cloud', click 'Get it now', and authorize 'Read Email Address' and 'App Storage scope' on your Jira site.

items.label: Configure Forge API Key (20–30+ Characters)
items.subLabel: In Jira Settings > Apps > Manage apps > User Identity Accessor > Configure, generate or enter a strong API Key and save it for the Jira Cloud Connector configuration.

items.label: Retrieve Webtrigger URL
items.subLabel: Copy the unique Webtrigger URL generated for your Jira site (e.g., https://YOUR_INSTANCE_ID.hello.atlassian-dev.net/x1/WEBTRIGGER_ID).

items.label: Verify Webtrigger & REST API Connectivity via curl
items.subLabel: Test the User Identity Accessor webtrigger endpoint (returns accountId and emailAddress JSON array) and verify Jira REST API reachability.
items.codeSnippet:
curl --location --request POST 'https://YOUR_INSTANCE_ID.hello.atlassian-dev.net/x1/ENDPOINT_PATH' \
  --header 'X-Api-Key: YOUR-API-KEY' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{ "accountIds": [ "ACCOUNT_ID_1", "ACCOUNT_ID_2" ] }'

# Verify Jira REST API reachability:
curl -v -u YOUR_EMAIL:YOUR_API_TOKEN \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://YOUR_DOMAIN.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/myself"

sections.title: Assistant Actions & Write Scopes

items.label: Actions Redirect URI Allowlisted

items.label: manage:jira-project (Classic Scope)

items.label: write:issue:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to create, edit, and transition Jira issues on behalf of the authenticated user.

items.label: write:comment:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to post and update comments on Jira issues.

items.label: write:attachment:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to upload and attach files to Jira issues.

items.label: write:project:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to create and update Jira project configurations.

items.label: write:issue-worklog:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to log work hours and update timesheets on Jira issues.

items.label: write:issue-link:jira (Granular Scope)
items.subLabel: Allows the assistant to link Jira issues together and manage issue dependencies.

sections.title: Dedicated Admin User, Network Allowlisting & Automated Health
sections.description: Create a dedicated administrator user in Jira Data Center, allowlist Google Cloud egress IPs, and verify automated connector health.

items.label: Create Dedicated Connector User & Add to jira-administrators
items.subLabel: In Jira Settings > User management, create a dedicated user (e.g., 'gemini-connector') and add them to the 'jira-administrators' group.

items.label: Network Reachability & Static IP Egress Allowlisting
items.subLabel: Ensure your on-premises or VPC firewall allows inbound HTTPS traffic from Google Cloud static IP egress ranges and presents a valid public CA SSL certificate.

items.label: Ingestion Credentials (Username/Password, PAT, or API Token)
items.subLabel: Note: Data Ingestion supports Username/Password, Personal Access Token (PAT), or API Token, and does NOT use the OAuth Client ID/Secret generated in the Application Link step.

items.label: Discovery Engine IAM Permission Check
items.subLabel: Verifies Discovery Engine Service Agent and Editor permissions on the GCP project.

automatedProbe.description: Checks Discovery Engine IAM role bindings on the project.

items.label: Connector Endpoint & Auth State Check
items.subLabel: Verifies non-redacted instance/tenant parameters, actionConfig state, and absence of 401/OAuth errors in GCP (note: client_id, client_secret, and vendor portal scopes are redacted by GCP on read and must be attested manually above).

automatedProbe.description: Verifies non-redacted connector endpoint/tenant parameters and checks for backend OAuth/auth errors in Discovery Engine.

items.label: Connector State & Sync Health
items.subLabel: Verifies the Jira Data Center connector state is ACTIVE with no crawl or auth errors.

automatedProbe.description: Checks Jira Data Center connector health status.

sections.title: Incoming OAuth 2.0 Application Link & Read Scopes
sections.description: Configure an incoming External Application link in Jira Administration > Applications > Application links.

items.label: Incoming External Application Link Provisioned
items.subLabel: In Jira Administration > Integrations > Application links, click 'Create link', select Application type 'External application' and Direction 'Incoming', and securely copy the auto-generated Client ID (Consumer Key) and Client Secret.

items.label: Redirect URL Configured
items.subLabel: Set the Application Link Redirect URL to https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect.

items.label: READ Scope (Application Link)
items.subLabel: Required to ingest and search Jira Data Center projects, comments, issues, attachments, and worklogs.

items.label: ADMIN Scope / jira-administrators Permission
items.subLabel: Ensures administrative metadata and project security schemes can be enumerated during ACL indexing.

sections.title: Assistant Actions & Write Scopes
sections.description: Application Link write scope required to perform Federated Search and Assistant Actions (creating/updating issues, comments, and attachments).

items.label: WRITE Scope (Application Link)
items.subLabel: Select 'WRITE' scope in the Jira Data Center Incoming Application Link (WRITE implies READ). Required for Federated Search and Actions such as creating issues, updating issues, updating comments, and uploading attachments.

sections.title: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) App Registration & Automated Health
sections.description: Create an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) integration in the Atlassian Developer Console, configure callback URLs and distribution sharing, and verify automated connector health.

items.label: Create OAuth 2.0 (3LO) Integration & Obtain Cloud ID
items.subLabel: Create an OAuth 2.0 Integration in Atlassian Developer Console, copy Client ID & Secret, and verify your cloudId via https://YOUR_INSTANCE.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info (Note: if using API token authentication, create an API token without scopes).

items.label: Callback URLs Registered
items.subLabel: Register https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/console/oauth/confluence_oauth.html (Data Ingestion & Actions) and https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect (Federated Search & Actions).

items.label: Distribution Sharing Enabled
items.subLabel: In Distribution controls, enable 'Sharing', set Vendor to 'Google', Privacy policy to 'https://policies.google.com', personal data to 'Yes', and confirm the personal data reporting API checkbox.

items.label: Discovery Engine IAM Permission Check
items.subLabel: Verifies the Confluence administrator has Discovery Engine Editor role and the project Service Agent is healthy.

automatedProbe.description: Checks Discovery Engine IAM role bindings on the host GCP project.

items.label: Connector Endpoint & Auth State Check
items.subLabel: Verifies non-redacted instance/tenant parameters, actionConfig state, and absence of 401/OAuth errors in GCP (note: client_id, client_secret, and vendor portal scopes are redacted by GCP on read and must be attested manually above).

automatedProbe.description: Verifies non-redacted connector endpoint/tenant parameters and checks for backend OAuth/auth errors in Discovery Engine.

items.label: Connector State & Sync Health
items.subLabel: Validates that the Confluence Cloud connector state is ACTIVE with no sync or auth failures.

automatedProbe.description: Validates Confluence Cloud connector status and sync logs.

sections.title: Identity & Email Visibility
sections.description: Required to map users and ACLs accurately. Warning: If user emails are private/restricted, the connector cannot map ACLs unless User Identity Accessor is installed.

items.label: Email Visibility Public ('Anyone' / 'Public')
items.subLabel: In Atlassian Account Profile and visibility > Contact, set visibility to 'Anyone', and in Confluence Settings > System > General Configuration, set 'User email visibility' to 'Public'. Grant 'User access admin' and 'Product admin' to the connector group.

items.label: Install 'User Identity Accessor for Confluence Cloud'
items.subLabel: If user email visibility is restricted, install 'User Identity Accessor for Confluence Cloud' from Atlassian Marketplace and grant 'Read Email Address' and 'App Storage scope'.

items.label: Configure Forge API Key / Client Secret
items.subLabel: In Confluence Settings > Apps > Manage apps > User Identity Accessor > Configure, generate a 20–30+ character API key and save it for the 'Confluence Identity Sync Forge Client Secret' field in Advanced Options.

items.label: Get Webtrigger URL & Verify via curl
items.subLabel: Copy the Webtrigger URL from the Apps administration page and verify that account IDs resolve to email addresses using the POST curl command.
